provenance.transformation_mode: PDF pages rasterized 160dpi grayscale and embedded as full-page JPEG into new 1-page PDF files; deterministic 5 variants/source

variants.skew_1p5deg: page rotated 1.5 degrees; bicubic; center crop, white canvas
variants.jpeg_noise: per-pixel zero-mean Gaussian sigma 8, fixed seed 20261105+source_index, JPEG quality 24
variants.lowres_blur: reduce to 60% dimensions bilinear, upscale bilinear, Gaussian blur radius 0.7
